content.title: XO, Kitty Season 4 Explained: Confirmation, Cast, & Everything We Know
content.text: Netflix Media Center Published Apr 2, 2026, 8:00 AM EDT Cher Thompson is a Senior Staff Writer at Screen Rant, where she covers everything from explosive reality TV moments to cast interviews about the twists and turns of scripted dramas. With a background in creative writing, marketing, and teaching, Cher knows how to spot both the storytelling genius and the guilty pleasures in pop culture. Her work blends wit with insight, making readers feel like they’re chatting with a friend who just happens to know way too much about TV. Sign in to your ScreenRant account XO, Kitty season 3, while rumored to be the end of the Netflix series, left the door wide open for the potential for more from Kitty Song Covey (Anna Cathcart) and the kids at KISS. Throughout XO, Kitty season 3, it was clear that senior year was finally upon the group of students Kitty's become a major part of since moving to Seoul. While Kitty, Yuri Han (Gia Kim), Min Ho Moon (Sang Heon Lee), Dae Kim (Choi Min-yeong), and Q Shabazian (Anthony Keyvan), have all become close throughout their time at KISS, the show made it clear that the group's time together was coming to an end. Throughout XO, Kitty season 3, the fall semester of their senior year passed by, leaving just months left for them at KISS together. Although XO, Kitty season 3 came to close in a way that made it seem like it could be the end of series, it also left the door open for another season of the Netflix series. XO, Kitty Season 4 Isn't Confirmed Yet With XO, Kitty season 3 coming to an end, many are already curious about what's to come for Kitty and the rest of her friends at KISS. XO, Kitty season 4 has yet to be confirmed, and it's possible that the show may not return at all considering the way Netflix has spoken about the show's third season. Regardless of what's next, XO, Kitty season 3 left things in an interesting position. The season came to a close with Kitty and Min Ho in the business class section of an airplane, headed to Kitty's native Portland after Min Ho chased after her at the airport to win her back. While the couple's reconciliation was sweet after their breakup earlier in the season, Kitty and Min Ho only having just gotten back together after their miscommunication feels like a missed opportunity for XO, Kitty. Viewers had the chance to see their relationship come to life early in the season, but there wasn't nearly enough of the pair for things to feel lived in on XO, Kitty. XO, Kitty Season 4 Potential Cast XO, Kitty season 4's potential cast, should it return for another season on Netflix, would likely be largely the same as it was throughout the third season. If the show is to come back, XO, Kitty would revolve around the final semester of Kitty's senior year at KISS. This means the majority of the cast would have to return, as they all comprise the same class. XO, Kitty Season 4 Potential Story Details Based On Season 3's Ending Netflix Media Center While XO, Kitty season 3's end made it clear that Kitty and Min Ho are ready to take the next step in their relationship by meeting Kitty's family, the series didn't make it specifically obvious what everyone else would be doing moving forward. While Yuri clearly has a future in fashion design, finishing out her senior year and mending her relationship with Julianna (Regan Aliyah) should be a priority. While Kitty made it clear that she would be headed to NYU in the fall for college, getting the chance to watch as she and Min Ho discuss their future is another natural step forward for the couple. With To All The Boys' third film putting Lara Jean (Lana Condor) and Peter Kavinsky's (Noah Centineo) relationship into long-distance mode, seeing Kitty do the same could be interesting. As for the rest of the cast, getting the chance to watch them navigate their next steps after KISS would be a great way to bid the series goodbye more fully. XO, Kitty also dropped the thread of Professor Alex Finnerty Lee (Peter Thurnwald) and Jiwon Ahn (Hojo Shin) having their first child this season, and delivering on their future feels like a must. Netflix Media Center While XO, Kitty season 4 isn't a definite yet, if the season does happen, it will likely begin filming quite quickly after season 3's end. XO, Kitty's first season was filmed in 2022, then released in 2023, but in the years since, things have had a different pace. While season 2 was renewed in mid 2023, it didn't film until the following year and then didn't release until 2025. XO, Kitty season 2 premiered in January 2025, and the third season was renewed the following month. By mid-year, the series was filming its third season, which gave the show a little over six months to turn around the final product. Now, with XO, Kitty season 3 premiering in March 2026, if it's to be renewed it would likely happen quickly thereafter. XO, Kitty season 4 may not be a foregone conclusion yet, but it's possible with the right numbers and a demand from viewers that Netflix could bring another season of the series to life.
